proposals.title: Airframe edge roughness lift
proposals.change: Add a thin unlit roughness breakup layer to the Yak airframe edge bands using existing airframe material controls.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the layer grayscale, low contrast, and limited to grazing-angle edge masks; preserve the existing L52 HF base response.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Uses a small unlit HF modulation on existing materials and does not darken the full FOV.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture YakBeauty and PropNose; verify edge breakup is visible without reducing either camera below Usable or creating black airframe patches.

proposals.title: Airframe normal micro-paneling
proposals.change: Add a subtle imported normal detail to the visible airframe panels for fine manufactured surface variation.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use low-strength tiling normal detail with neutral base color and no added metallic darkness.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only changes high-frequency normal response while retaining the frozen unlit material family.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Prop and PropNose; confirm panel highlights gain readable microstructure and no large dark or washed-out regions appear.

proposals.title: Airframe AO seam restraint
proposals.change: Introduce a restrained AO seam mask at major panel joins on the airframe.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit AO multiplication to narrow seams and cap intensity so broad aircraft surfaces remain mid-tone.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Localized seam-only AO preserves the existing exposure and avoids dark PBR-like FOV coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture YakBeauty and Cockpit; verify seam definition improves while the fuselage and cockpit frame remain readable and non-black.

proposals.title: Airframe dust gradient
proposals.change: Add a thin warm dirt gradient along lower airframe surfaces.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-opacity world-up mask with a warm gray-brown tint and no full-surface albedo replacement.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The gradient is thin, low-opacity, and remains within the frozen unlit airframe treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture PropHub and YakBeauty; confirm lower-surface dirt reads as a narrow material cue without reducing overall aircraft separation.

proposals.title: Airframe rivet value speckle
proposals.change: Add sparse light-value rivet and fastener speckle to the airframe material.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep rivet marks brighter than the surrounding metal and restrict them to a sparse microdetail mask.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Positive-value microdetail increases recognition without introducing dark FOV material coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Prop and ADS; verify fastener texture is legible at close range and does not create noisy high-contrast aliasing.

proposals.title: Airframe paint scuff accents
proposals.change: Add two or three small pale scuff patches to high-contact airframe zones.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tiny additive masks with subdued neutral-white response; place only on already bright panel edges.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny additive accents are bounded to existing bright edges and cannot turn the FOV into a dark material field.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture PropNose and YakBeauty; confirm scuffs improve authored wear readability without visible glow or camera usability loss.

proposals.title: Airframe moisture stain breakup
proposals.change: Add a faint vertical moisture-stain texture to one exposed airframe side panel.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the accent on a small background aircraft prop beyond the wall depth and keep the stain low contrast.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The weathering is behind the wall and cannot alter hero-camera FOV material coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture City; verify the stain is visible as a small background detail and all 11 cameras remain Usable.

proposals.title: Prop disc hub contrast ring
proposals.change: Add a narrow bright contrast ring around the propeller hub on the prop disc material.

proposals.capture_safe_reason: A small additive hub cue improves disc orientation without changing the disc's broad value or adding a dark material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture PropHub and PropNose; verify hub center and disc boundary are easier to locate with no halo washout.

proposals.title: Prop disc blade-sector breakup
proposals.change: Add two subtle alternating value sectors to the prop disc blur texture.

proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sector breakup is a restrained unlit disc detail and preserves the frozen overall exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Prop and PropHub; confirm blade rotation reads as a disc with directional structure rather than an undifferentiated circle.

proposals.title: Prop disc edge highlight tick
proposals.change: Add four tiny neutral highlight ticks at the prop disc perimeter.

proposals.title: Rifle tan fabric grain

proposals.title: Submarine rescue stripe
proposals.change: Add one narrow high-visibility orange rescue stripe to submarine_proxy behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Apply one stripe only to the upper hull, keep the submarine rearward at x>=bx+3, and avoid dark-only hull replacement.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The stripe is a tiny rear-plane authored accent that adds color without enlarging the submarine hero mass or darkening ocean FOV.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean and Harbor remain usable; the stripe is visible as a restrained orange identifier with no black-pixel spike.

proposals.title: Rifle sight-edge emissive rim
proposals.change: Add a thin warm emissive rim along the rifle irons proxy sight housing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-intensity masked overlay mesh or material layer; preserve the existing ADS HF checker/stripe material underneath.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive emissive accent stays within the frozen ADS composition and does not introduce a dark sole FOV material.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; HF checkers/stripes remain visible; sight housing gains a readable edge highlight without clipping.

proposals.title: Barrel-bore highlight cue
proposals.change: Add a narrow emissive crescent at the visible barrel-bore opening.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the crescent small and offset from the bore center so the opening remains legible rather than becoming a filled bright disc.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A tiny emissive proxy improves barrel recognition without changing the HF base or adding a dark material.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; bore opening reads at capture resolution; no full-disc washout or checker loss occurs.

proposals.title: Glove trigger-contact marker
proposals.change: Add a small emissive contact notch where the glove meets the trigger guard.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the accent only at the contact seam, using a subdued amber value and no broad glove recolor.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is localized to an existing glove-rifle junction and leaves all frozen HF surfaces unchanged.
proposals.acceptance_test: Both ADS and Cockpit remain Usable; contact seam is visible; no emissive spill reaches the sight picture.

proposals.title: Igla nose stripe
proposals.change: Add one thin emissive identification stripe to the Igla proxy nose section.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short stripe aligned to the nose contour; do not cover the underlying HF checker/stripe field.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single thin additive stripe increases Igla silhouette identification with negligible screen coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; Igla nose reads as a distinct object; HF stripes remain intact around it.

proposals.title: Igla fin-tip glints
proposals.change: Add two tiny emissive glints to the visible Igla fin tips.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the effect to two sub-pixel-to-pixel tip accents with low exposure response.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny tip accents improve fin readability without adding a large hero element or altering base materials.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; both visible fin tips separate from the background; no bright bloom obscures the sight picture.

proposals.title: Iron-sight post cap
proposals.change: Add a small emissive cap to the top of the front iron-sight post.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a thin rectangular cap matching the post width; preserve the open sight gap and HF pattern behind it.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is a small additive cue on an existing sight landmark and does not fill the reticle gap.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; front post and sight gap remain clearly separated; checker/stripe density is unchanged.

proposals.title: Rear-aperture locator dot
proposals.change: Add one dim emissive locator dot beside the rear aperture of the irons proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the dot outside the aperture opening so it supports orientation without becoming a second aiming point.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One low-intensity pixel-scale cue improves rear-sight localization without touching the frozen HF base.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; aperture remains open; locator dot is visible but does not compete with the front post.

proposals.title: Glove knuckle-plane accent
proposals.change: Add a narrow emissive accent across the glove knuckle plane nearest the rifle grip.
proposals.implementation_notes: Mask a single short segment on the existing glove geometry; retain the glove's HF pattern and avoid a full-hand material override.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A tiny anatomical edge cue gives the glove readable form while maintaining all frozen unlit HF detail.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; knuckle plane separates from the rifle grip; no broad glove brightening occurs.

proposals.title: Magazine-lip contour accent
proposals.change: Add a thin emissive line along the visible magazine-lip contour of the rifle proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Restrict the line to the upper lip contour and keep intensity below the iron-sight accents.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The localized additive line improves weapon-part segmentation without replacing or obscuring HF stripes.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; magazine lip is distinguishable; line does not read as a large glowing weapon body.

proposals.title: Charging-handle notch
proposals.change: Add a small emissive notch at the visible charging-handle position.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short masked notch with hard edges and no animation or particle trail.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A small hard-edged additive mark improves recognition of a functional rifle cue with minimal coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; charging-handle notch is readable; no bloom crosses the sight alignment.

proposals.title: Igla seeker collar ring
proposals.change: Add a thin emissive ring around the Igla seeker collar.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a partial ring if necessary to avoid a solid luminous band; keep the center and HF surface visible.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A narrow collar ring strengthens Igla identity while remaining a low-area additive accent.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; seeker collar separates from adjacent geometry; no solid dark or bright material replaces the base.

proposals.title: Glove-thumb grip contact seam
proposals.change: Add a short emissive seam at the glove thumb-to-grip contact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the seam under the thumb silhouette and use a low-intensity warm-neutral color.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The seam is confined to an existing contact boundary and cannot replace the HF densify field.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS and Cockpit remain Usable; thumb contact reads clearly; no visible material change spreads across the glove.

proposals.title: Front-sight side tick
proposals.change: Add one small emissive side tick to the front iron-sight blade.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the tick on one side of the blade, leaving the central aiming post unchanged.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single small side cue improves blade orientation without introducing a competing center marker.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; central sight alignment is unchanged; tick is visible only as a minor orientation cue.

proposals.title: Barrel seam dash
proposals.change: Add a short emissive dash at the visible barrel-to-receiver seam.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one broken dash rather than a continuous ring to preserve the sparse, thin-accent look.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The broken dash adds a unique weapon landmark while retaining the frozen HF checker/stripe material.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; barrel and receiver read as separate forms; dash stays below glare and bloom thresholds.

proposals.title: Igla fin-root seam
proposals.change: Add one short emissive seam at the root of the visible Igla guidance fin.
proposals.implementation_notes: Follow the fin root for a few pixels only; do not outline the entire fin or body.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A tiny fin-root seam clarifies Igla construction with negligible screen-space impact.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; fin root is distinguishable; existing HF stripes remain visible on the adjacent Igla surface.

proposals.title: Glove index-finger edge cue
proposals.change: Add a thin emissive edge cue along the index finger silhouette near the trigger.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the cue to the outward silhouette edge and leave the finger interior untouched.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The edge-only accent improves glove-versus-rifle separation without a full glove recolor.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; index finger silhouette is readable; no cue overlaps the front sight post.

proposals.title: Sight-block micro bevel
proposals.change: Add a tiny unlit high-frequency bevel strip to the side of the rear sight block.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a narrow checker-compatible HF strip only; do not use a solid dark PBR or dark metal material and do not alter the main ADS HF field.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The strip is unlit HF-only and preserves the capture freeze's checker/stripe treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; rear sight block gains a readable side edge; HF pattern density does not decrease.

proposals.title: Igla body break accent
proposals.change: Add one short additive emissive break mark on the Igla body behind the seeker collar.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single diagonal mark sized below the collar ring; keep it away from the sight centerline.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The mark is small, additive, and spatially separated from the primary aiming cue.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; Igla body orientation is clearer; no HF checker/stripe region is replaced.

proposals.title: Grip-index alignment dash
proposals.change: Add a small emissive alignment dash where the glove index line meets the rifle grip contour.
proposals.implementation_notes: Treat the dash as one contact accent spanning the seam; keep it shorter than the glove contact marker.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is confined to one glove-rifle seam and adds no broad hero geometry.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; glove-to-grip alignment reads immediately; no visible loss of ADS HF detail occurs.

proposals.title: Muzzle-side identification tick
proposals.change: Add one tiny emissive identification tick on the visible muzzle sidewall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the tick perpendicular to the muzzle edge, with low intensity and no bloom-heavy treatment.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A pixel-scale additive tick provides a unique muzzle cue while leaving the HF densify intact.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; muzzle sidewall is distinguishable; tick does not become a dominant bright artifact or obscure the sight picture.

proposals.title: Compact muzzle-flash core
proposals.change: Add a small additive emissive NS_MuzzleFlash core burst at the primary weapon muzzle.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short-lived, low-area sprite or mesh core with restrained brightness and no opaque smoke component.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive emissive proxy remains visible without introducing dark FOV coverage or PBR materials.
proposals.acceptance_test: Loop52 recipe captures 11/11 usable; muzzle flash reads as a compact bright event in Combat and ADS.

proposals.title: Muzzle-flash directional blade
proposals.change: Add one thin additive emissive directional blade to NS_MuzzleFlash aligned with the barrel axis.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the blade to one narrow card or low-poly strip and keep its lifetime below the flash envelope.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The blade is thin, bright, and additive, so it adds silhouette detail without forming a dark wall.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropNose and ADS retain usable framing with a single directional flash accent visible at the muzzle.

proposals.title: Localized gun-smoke wisp
proposals.change: Add one small upward gun-smoke wisp from NS_GunSmoke immediately after the muzzle flash.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-opacity additive or translucency-safe wisp with narrow bounds, low spawn count, and rapid dissipation.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single thin localized wisp avoids the prohibited dark smoke wall and does not occlude the frozen HF composition.
proposals.acceptance_test: Combat remains usable and the smoke occupies only the immediate muzzle area without lowering scene readability.

proposals.title: Twin gun-smoke wisps
proposals.change: Split NS_GunSmoke into two narrow offset wisps that curl away from the muzzle.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep each wisp smaller than the original single plume, with low opacity and no connected screen-space mass.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Separated thin wisps preserve FOV openness and add motion cues without creating a dark continuous obstruction.
proposals.acceptance_test: Cockpit and Combat remain usable; both wisps stay localized and do not merge into a smoke wall.

proposals.title: Single hit-spark star
proposals.change: Add one compact additive emissive starburst from NS_HitSparks at the principal impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one burst with a short lifetime, narrow radius, and warm-white core with a restrained amber fringe.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The spark is an additive point accent and cannot form a dark FOV region.
proposals.acceptance_test: Impact reads clearly in Combat and PropHub while both captures remain usable.

proposals.title: Three-line hit-spark spray
proposals.change: Replace the broad NS_HitSparks burst with three thin additive emissive spark lines directed along the impact normal.
proposals.implementation_notes: Cap the particle count at three and keep each line short enough to remain a localized accent.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Thin additive lines provide crisp impact edges without adding opaque or dark coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropNose and Combat stay usable and show three readable sparks at the selected impact point.

proposals.title: Drone explosion flash pin
proposals.change: Add a small additive emissive flash pin at the center of NS_DroneExplosion.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a compact core-only event and suppress any large smoke volume or opaque debris in the frozen FOV.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is a small bright proxy that adds event readability without a dark explosion mass.
proposals.acceptance_test: City and Wide remain usable with the drone event legible as a localized flash.

proposals.title: Drone explosion ember pair
proposals.change: Add two tiny additive emissive ember particles trailing from NS_DroneExplosion.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use exactly two low-area embers with short lifetimes and no smoke-sheet expansion.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Two isolated emissive dots add scale and aftermath detail while leaving the FOV open.
proposals.acceptance_test: City and Combat retain usable captures; embers remain separate and do not become a plume.

proposals.title: Low-count flak puffs
proposals.change: Reduce NS_FlakBurst to three small additive emissive puff-ring accents around the burst center.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use thin rings with low opacity and tight radius; omit broad dark smoke and large opaque clouds.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Thin additive rings preserve the Loop52 composition and avoid dark flak-wall coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: City and Wide stay usable with three distinct flak accents visible at the burst location.

proposals.title: Flak spark needle
proposals.change: Add one vertical additive emissive spark needle to NS_FlakBurst.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the needle narrow, short-lived, and offset from the aircraft silhouette to prevent silhouette merging.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single thin emissive mark adds high-frequency detail without occluding the scene.
proposals.acceptance_test: Combat and Wide remain usable; the needle reads as a separate flak detail rather than a dark obstruction.

proposals.title: Prop-wash crescent
proposals.change: Add one thin additive emissive crescent ribbon to NS_PropWash behind the prop disc.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the crescent narrow and partially segmented so it reads as airflow instead of a filled disc.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The crescent is additive and sparse, preserving the prop and nose readability in close cameras.
proposals.acceptance_test: Prop and PropHub remain usable; the crescent stays behind the prop and does not fill the frame.

proposals.title: Prop-wash pulse tick
proposals.change: Add one short additive emissive pulse tick at the lower edge of NS_PropWash.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single narrow arc or line with a low intensity multiplier and no opaque turbulence volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The isolated additive tick adds a controlled edge cue without darkening the prop FOV.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropNose remains usable and the pulse tick does not overlap the primary nose silhouette.

proposals.title: Paired tracer streaks
proposals.change: Add two short additive emissive tracer streaks to NS_TracerBurst along the existing firing direction.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the burst to two narrow streaks with restrained bloom and a short screen-space length.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Short additive streaks provide directional detail without forming a bright wash or opaque band.
proposals.acceptance_test: Combat and ADS remain usable; both tracers are visible but do not cross the key aircraft silhouette.

proposals.title: Single tracer head
proposals.change: Add one compact additive emissive tracer head particle to NS_TracerBurst.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the head small with a controlled halo and no extra trail or smoke ribbon.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single point-like emissive proxy has negligible FOV coverage and no dark-material risk.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropNose and Combat remain usable with one clear tracer head at the intended trajectory.

proposals.title: Thin ocean spray fan
proposals.change: Add a three-particle additive emissive spray fan to NS_OceanSpray at the principal wave break.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tiny cool-white droplets with narrow spread, low count, and no opaque foam sheet.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny bright droplets preserve ocean readability and avoid broad dark or washed-out water coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean and Harbor remain usable; spray is confined to the selected wave break.

proposals.title: Single splash crown
proposals.change: Add one small additive emissive splash crown to NS_WaterSplash at the impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a thin partial crown with low brightness and suppress any full opaque splash column.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The crown is a small additive accent that adds a readable impact edge without blocking the horizon.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean and City stay usable; the crown remains smaller than the local impact region.

proposals.title: Short missile-trail dash
proposals.change: Add one short additive emissive dash to NS_MissileTrail immediately behind the missile head.
proposals.implementation_notes: Restrict trail length and width to a single narrow dash; disable long translucent ribbons in the frozen views.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The short additive dash gives trajectory evidence without creating a large hero stack or dark screen region.
proposals.acceptance_test: Combat and Wide remain usable; the trail stays attached to the missile and does not span the FOV.

proposals.title: Water-splash droplet pair
proposals.change: Add two isolated additive emissive droplets to NS_WaterSplash above the splash origin.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two small droplets with separate trajectories and a very short lifetime; avoid a connected spray sheet.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse additive droplets add high-frequency water detail with negligible occlusion.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Ocean remain usable and both droplets are visually separated from the horizon line.

proposals.title: Muzzle-to-hit spark link
proposals.change: Add one thin additive emissive connector streak between the muzzle event and the nearest hit-spark event.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single short connector only when both endpoints are already in frame; keep it thin and disable it when alignment is ambiguous.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The connector is additive, conditional, and narrow, avoiding broad hero stacking and dark FOV coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Combat and ADS remain usable; the connector reads as one clean directional cue without obscuring aircraft edges.

proposals.title: Harbor flak-water accent
proposals.change: Add one tiny additive emissive impact spark at the waterline where NS_FlakBurst meets NS_OceanSpray.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one point-sized spark with a short lifetime and no additional flak cloud or spray volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single additive waterline point adds event specificity while preserving the frozen ocean and harbor composition.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Ocean remain usable; the accent is localized to the waterline and does not create a dark or washed-out patch.
